# F5 Distributed Cloud Terraform Provider

> Provider: f5-sales-demo/xcsh | Registry: <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/f5-sales-demo/xcsh>

DEPRECATED — do not use: volterraedge/volterra

## Required Block

    terraform {
      required_providers {
        xcsh = {
          source = "f5-sales-demo/xcsh"
        }
      }
    }

## Syntax Rules

- OneOf selectors: use empty block `field {}`, never `field = true`
- Cross-resource refs: block with name + namespace attributes
- Boolean attributes: use `= true` / `= false`
- Fields marked "Server applies default when omitted" can be safely omitted

## Resource Categories

- [Uncategorized](_llms-txt/uncategorized.txt) (33 resources): Resources pending categorization
- [Security](_llms-txt/security.txt) (25 resources): WAF, bot defense, rate limiting, firewall policies, and security controls
- [Networking](_llms-txt/networking.txt) (12 resources): Virtual networks, BGP, cloud connectivity, tunnels, and network interfaces
- [Sites](_llms-txt/sites.txt) (9 resources): AWS/Azure/GCP VPC sites, SecureMesh, VoltStack, and site mesh groups
- [Load Balancing](_llms-txt/load-balancing.txt) (8 resources): HTTP/TCP/UDP/CDN load balancers, origin pools, health checks, and routing
- [DNS](_llms-txt/dns.txt) (6 resources): DNS domains, zones, compliance checks, and DNS proxy configuration
- [Kubernetes](_llms-txt/kubernetes.txt) (6 resources): Container registries, workloads, and Kubernetes integrations
- [API Security](_llms-txt/api-security.txt) (5 resources): API definition, discovery, testing, and security controls for web APIs
- [Authentication](_llms-txt/authentication.txt) (4 resources): Authentication methods, cloud credentials, and secret management
- [Monitoring](_llms-txt/monitoring.txt) (4 resources): Log receivers, alert policies, alert templates, and global logging configuration
- [VPN](_llms-txt/vpn.txt) (4 resources): VPN and IPSec configuration
- [Certificates](_llms-txt/certificates.txt) (3 resources): TLS certificates, certificate chains, CRLs, and trusted CA lists
- [Cloud Resources](_llms-txt/cloud-resources.txt) (3 resources): Cloud elastic IPs, address allocators, and geo-location resources
- [Organization](_llms-txt/organization.txt) (3 resources): Namespaces, tenant configuration, and organizational settings
- [Applications](_llms-txt/applications.txt) (2 resources): Application settings, types, discovery, and filtering
- [BIG-IP Integration](_llms-txt/big-ip-integration.txt) (1 resources): BIG-IP proxy, data groups, and iRules integration
- [Integrations](_llms-txt/integrations.txt) (1 resources): External integrations including code base and ticket tracking

## Data Sources

Read-only data sources for querying existing F5 XC objects across all resource categories.
